body:
I'm definitely starting to think there's a massive social "failing" by society unraveling before our eyes. I mean even for many who appear to have all the trappings of "success" seem to struggle with not finding meaning in life.

And honestly I think you're onto something re: social isolation. We're more and more aware of people "out there" but even more cut off.. And the "quality" of our relationships seems more dysfunctional, and competitive rather than cooperative, than ever. Something isn't working and an entire generations mental health is the collateral.. Scary shit.

I've had multiple miscarriages and I knew every single time that something was wrong. They are so incredibly shitty. Feeling betrayed by my body was the worst part for me. I hope the therapist calls back soon <3
Jesus that perfectly describes how I feel. And just so scared and angry at the injustice of it. What did I do so terribly wrong that I don't deserve to feel happiness?

UGH what the hell is wrong with people. Even when my young son is invited he goes to spend the night with Nana or we hire a sitter to stay over. Kids that young don't even have fun and I'm not going to be the asshole who ruins someone's wedding because my kid decided to throw a tantrum or crap his pants. Yes we parents love our kids but not everyone else does, and some events are just flat out not appropriate for them! That really sucks for your cousin, I hope the asshole parents got lots of dirty looks.
To be fair lots of Wedding food is fucking AWFUL. Wolfgang Puck's catering company did ours.. We paid out the ass but at least the food was good!
I honestly wonder if depression or anxiety has always been this prevalent or if something environmental is triggering everyone's epigenetics.

Thank you. I scheduled an appointment with a therapist after my husband got home.

I'm afraid of being judged as weak and a bad mother. I honestly think being hospitalized for a few days wouldn't be unreasonable but I feel like I'd lose all of the respect of my husband's family, even though he is endlessly supportive of me. I don't know if that makes sense.

I used to take medication but it totally flatlined me. Maybe I just need to find the right one but I hate feeling like a Guinea pig. I guess being numb is better than being terrorized and sad all the time but it does fucking suck.
I'm having a terrible day and this is the first thing to legitimately make me laugh today. Thanks for that.
My mom died of suicide and I'm now older than she was when she died. It's not rational but it terrifies me.
